welcome.title: Welcome to Kokoro
welcome.text: All your recipes will live here. Let me show you around, it won’t take long.

home.title: Your recipes
home.text: Everything you’ve saved is gathered here on the home screen.

add.title: Add recipes
add.text: Paste a link from any website, upload a photo or write the recipe yourself.

search.title: Quick search
search.text: Start typing a name and the recipe will turn up.

filter.title: Filters
filter.text: Pick a category or tags to see only what you need.

sections.title: Everything in its place
sections.text: Your categories and tags live here. Create your own so recipes don’t get lost.

menu.title: Menu
menu.text: Settings, theme and language. You can take this tour again from “How to use”.
